questions.question: When Saul sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him, what did David ask God to do?

answers.text: Give him a sword to fight back
Help him make peace with Saul

questions.question: David asked the LORD God of Israel to rouse Himself and punish the nations. What did David ask for the wicked traitors?
David asked God to scatter his enemies instead of killing them. Why did he ask this?

answers.text: So his people would not forget
So his enemies could turn back
So he could show them mercy

questions.question: David prayed that people would know God rules over Jacob. How far did he want this to be known?

answers.text: To the ends of the earth
